items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Shirley upset everybody, playing a whole new context, you know.

ctx.x: So when you got that, you'd been in his band, everybody would look at you. All the guitar players from all over, in every band, looking at you. Well, you're playing just about the same chords they're playing until Charlie Christian came on the scene. Jimmy Shirley upset everybody, playing a whole new context, you know.
